claim: Widening checkpoint differences from 20 to 100 training updates did not yield a reliable improvement in LoRAcle recognition on this fixed toy suite.

actual_learning.strong_rule: After >=0.8 and gain >=0.5 on 16 held-out prompts; descriptive only.

patterns: Wide assisted released interpretations call both sort and reverse changes alphabetical ordering in all three initializations.
They call both capital and creature-diet changes creature diets in all three initializations.
Sorting improves by two recognized cases while numbered-list recognition loses one.
Zero input still produces a specific numbered-list claim and invented automobile descriptions.
limits: One base/interpreter, eight curated tasks in four pairs, three reused initialization seeds and repeated examples; development only.
Four-cluster tests have only 16 assignments; absence of significance is not proof of no signal.
Task-label exchangeability is an assumption, not randomized assignment of meanings.
Topic matches do not validate invented names, facts, or the correctness of added details.
Rank-32 effective differences are compressed to rank16 and normalized before interpretation; not arbitrary update decoding or effect-size estimation.
Sentence-aware assistant scoring was locked before target join; prior familiarity with tasks prevents fully independent blindness.
Original 7/24 is historical only; current matched short baseline is 6/24.
decision: Requested wider-gap follow-up is complete. No further experiments or sweeps. Delete the completion heartbeat; keep chat open.
